# Crux Studios

> Crux Studios is a full-stack software development studio based in Bangalore, India. We architect high-performance distributed systems, build zero-bloat web applications, and engineer software that scales.

## Overview
- **Location:** Bangalore, India (Serves clients worldwide).
- **Core Principles:** Zero-bloat engineering, minimal dependencies, right tool for the job, and direct developer communication (no middlemen).
- **Primary Technologies:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, and WebSockets.

## Services
- **UI/UX Design:** User flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity screens designed to solve real user problems.
- **Frontend Development:** Accessible, responsive React/Next.js applications built from scratch (no generic templates).
- **Backend & Database Design:** Node.js APIs, distributed caching (Redis), and database architecture (PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
- **Integrations:** Payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay) and custom real-time messaging pipelines.

## Projects Shipped
- **HonorLog:** Achievement and grading tracking platform for martial arts academies (built with Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL).
- **EntryDesk:** Lean, custom visitor management check-in app (built with React, Express, and MongoDB).
- **RingFlow:** Streamlined call flow and team communication pipeline management (built with React, WebSockets, and REST APIs).
- **Drawer:** Open-source tournament brackets generator for Karate events (built with Python, pandas, ReportLab, and Docker).

## Team

- **Ullas M:** Full-Stack Developer focusing on backend, systems, and infrastructure.
